wrapper.name: SCDraw_Counter
wrapper.text:
---- MODULE SCDraw_Counter ----
EXTENDS Counter
LOCAL INSTANCE Naturals
SCDraw_Counter_TLC == INSTANCE TLC
SCDraw_Counter_Budget == SCDraw_Counter_TLC!TLCGet("distinct") <= 500
SCDraw_Counter_Broken == (IF BelowThree THEN {} ELSE {"BelowThree"})
SCDraw_Counter_Mark == IF SCDraw_Counter_Broken = {} THEN TRUE ELSE SCDraw_Counter_TLC!PrintT(<<"00000000000000000000000000000000", <<n>>, SCDraw_Counter_Broken>>)
====
